source: Grüneis et al., DOI 10.1002/mnfr.202000472, Results insulin prose and Figure 4A–B. NRC PMC7900990.
operator: positive baseline-subtracted trapezoidal insulin area 0–120 min; arithmetic mean ± SEM
unit: Figure 4A concentrations in μIU/mL imply μIU·min/mL for integrated area; Figure 4B caption prints mg/dL × min (glucose units). Native numerical unit bridge conditional.
design: Randomized balanced crossover, all 27 healthy men received both 30 g untreated sugars and both lactisole conditions; 12 h fast.
exposure: Acquisition investigator saw exact target before freeze; coordinator learned qualitative direction before and means after freezing EXTERNAL_PLAN. No blinding claim.
kept_separate: Lactisole arms, other endpoints and incomplete unit label.
